paras: Wilsonosaura josyi is a species of lizard in the family Gymnophthalmidae. The species, which is endemic to Peru, is monotypic in the genus Wilsonosaura.
The specific name, josyi, is in honor of Franz-Josef "Josy" Hans.
W. josyi is found in central Peru, in Department of Junín.
The holotype of W. josyi was collected at an altitude of 2,880 m (9,450 ft), but its preferred natural habitat was not recorded.
